The World's Most Beautiful Parkour Stage
Sept 13–19, 2027 Vieste, Puglia, Italy 100% Free to Watch Open to Every Athlete on Earth
The Event
An Ancient City.
A Living Course.

Parkour is the fastest growing sport in the world, with a global audience that skews young, passionate, and highly engaged. And there is no better place on earth to watch it than Vieste. Athletes compete across the rooftops, alleys, and coastal bluffs of the historic old town, enhanced by a custom-built obstacle course integrated directly into the natural architecture. No warehouse. No manufactured setting. The city is the stage.

01
Marina Piccola
The social heart of the week. DJ sets, live music, athlete meet-and-greets. Every evening. The energy never stops.
02
Old Town Rooftops
Narrow limestone alleys, centuries-old architecture, and a custom-built course integrated into the streets. The ultimate urban stage.
03
La Ripa Cliffs
White limestone cliffs over turquoise Adriatic water. 12m natural cliff + 18m artificial tower. Home of Kings of the Cliffs.

The Advantage
Free to Watch.
Impossible
to Ignore.

Most action sports events charge for admission. Vieste Parkour doesn't. Every person who shows up is there for one reason only — they love the sport. There are no casual ticket buyers, no corporate obligation crowd. Just genuine fans of movement who chose to be there.

No fence separates your brand from the audience. No barrier caps who can attend. The entire city of Vieste is your stage — and 2,000+ passionate fans walked into it in 2025.

"The audience is free to enter — which means every person there is a genuine fan of the sport."

The Programme
Seven Days.
Zero Filler.

Six distinct events. One week of movement, music, culture, and community — built around a sport that refuses to be contained. Every event free to watch. Every format designed around Vieste's unique geography.

01
Vieste Open
Head-to-head freerunning. Single elimination. One male + one female champion crowned at the final ceremony on September 19.
02
Street Lines
Pure freerunning expression on rooftops and stone streets. Athletes pick their lines, own their style, compete head-to-head.
03
Speed Run
A race through the labyrinthine alleys of the old town. Point A to point B. Fastest time wins. Brutally technical.
04
Kings of the Cliffs
Elite cliff diving. 12m + 18m platforms. La Ripa Cliffs.
05
Youth Jam
Next-generation athletes. Free workshops. Professional coaching. No experience required. The future starts here.
06
Open Jams
Every evening, every night of the week. The community is the event — athletes, locals, visitors. No ticket, no barrier.

OF
THE
CLIFFS
Signature Event
Kings of
the Cliffs

Elite cliff diving from the La Ripa coastal bluffs over the Adriatic. Custom-built platforms. Judged on technique, execution, and difficulty. The most visually spectacular event of the week — and the most shareable content of the year.

12M
Natural Cliff Platform
18M

LA RIPA
Coastal Bluffs · Vieste

After-party and awards at Pelikano Restaurant & Beach Club. The dive is the content. The after-party is the relationship. Sponsors are at the heart of both moments — and both end up online.
